mapper.select: SELECT financial_goal_id, user_id, goal_type, custom_goal_name, target_amount, current_amount, target_months, created_at, updated_at FROM financial_goals WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_goals ( user_id, goal_type, custom_goal_name, target_amount, current_amount, target_months ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{goalType}, #{customGoalName}, #{targetAmount}, #{currentAmount}, #{targetMonths} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE goal_type = VALUES(goal_type), custom_goal_name = VALUES(custom_goal_name), target_amount = VALUES(target_amount), current_amount = VALUES(current_amount), target_months = VALUES(target_months), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
